title: Correlated quantum criticality and topological magnetoelectric response in Bi2Se3
abstract: A defining feature of quantum materials is that multiple orders govern low-energy physics and are not independent. We study Bi$_2$Se$_3$ by combining DFT with a renormalized correlated honeycomb model in which frustrated magnetic order and helical topological surface states are coupled via one control parameter. The surface states map to a honeycomb Hubbard model with frustrated $J_1$--$J_2$ exchange. Exact diagonalization up to 20 sites shows the Néel structure factor and valence-bond-solid order parameter cross at $J_2/J_1 \approx 0.22$, agreeing with QMC/DMRG, and a dynamical spin structure factor broadens near the crossover, as expected for a spinon continuum. Band inversion of the renormalized tight-binding model occurs on the same critical locus, producing jumps in the Chern number and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant mirrored by the skyrmion charge $Q$. This gives a microscopic link: $Q$ selects the axion angle and thus the topological magnetoelectric coupling. We distinguish axion coupling, independent of skyrmion helicity, from the helicity-dependent magnetoelectric multipole coupling, whose toroidal component scales as $\sin\gamma$ and vanishes for Néel-type textures. We derive the $Q$-topological magnetoelectric energy and estimate $\sim 10^{-20}\,\mathrm{J}$ per skyrmion per cycle for few-tesla fields. The cycle is thermodynamically bounded: constant-$\theta$ cycles extract no net work, and efficiency is limited by axionic entropy change.

title: When do machine-learning potentials need a configuration-dependent kernel? Learning long-range interactions with Fourier neural operators
abstract: Long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials are commonly treated by coupling learned sources through either a prescribed electrostatic kernel or a learned but configuration-independent one. Whether such a kernel suffices depends on the underlying screened interaction. We address this question by using Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to learn how latent source fields, built from the descriptors of a local backbone (here MACE), interact across the simulation cell. For a synthetic ionic system with tunable screening, a prescribed Coulomb kernel underestimates the long-wavelength charge fluctuations by 43% under strong screening, whereas the FNO reproduces them within 3% and recovers 95-99% of the variance of the residual left by the local backbone. A linear FNO, which learns a configuration-independent kernel, performs equally well in the homogeneous case. Under inhomogeneous screening, rearranging the remote medium modulates the coupling between distant ions, a dependence that no configuration-independent kernel can represent. Among the models tested, only the nonlinear FNO responds to this modulation, and its force errors are 27-41% lower than those of configuration-independent models. In first-principles benchmarks of liquid water, lithium lanthanum zirconate, and Au2/MgO(001), MACE-FNO is comparable to a prescribed-kernel model for the bulk systems and more accurate for the interface. It further captures the reversal of the Au2 wetting preference induced by remote Al dopants, with deviations below 5 meV per cell from density functional theory. These results indicate that a configuration-dependent kernel, as learned by FNOs, becomes necessary once the screening medium varies, even though the energy remains quadratic in the charges for a fixed medium.

title: Restricted triangular ice beyond the solvable manifolds: chiral ice and the critical region of dominant chiral vertices
abstract: We study two restrictions of Baxter's symmetric twenty-vertex model on the triangular lattice, in which the three classes of vertices allowed by the ice rule carry the weights $a$, $b$ and $c$: chiral ice, in which only the twelve chiral vertices are allowed, and the model that excludes only the two alternating vertices. We show that neither model belongs to any of the known exactly solvable families of the twenty-vertex model, and we characterise chiral ice as the ice model in which every vertex has exactly one through line, a property that imposes a parity constraint along every closed lattice line. We compute the residual entropies of both models with transfer matrices on cylinders of up to twelve vertices in circumference, extrapolated with the finite-size correction predicted by conformal invariance, which we adapt to the triangular geometry and verify at two exactly solved points. The number of upward arrows crossing the cylinder is conserved, and the cost of changing it shows that both models are critical, with the long-distance behaviour of a free massless field. Chiral ice is the extreme point of a region of the phase diagram in which ordering had been suggested; along two paths through that region we find the same critical behaviour at every point, with no feature at the proposed boundary of the region. Along Baxter's exactly solved curve we obtain the corresponding exponents in closed form.

title: Agentic inverse design of spatially programmed materials
abstract: Spatially programmed functional materials, from functionally graded alloys and metamaterials to quantum superlattices, use their spatial structure to tailor physical properties. However, translating a desired spatial structure into a practical fabrication recipe remains challenging due to the complex relationship between processing conditions and resulting material structures. Here we show that a large language model (LLM) agent can inverse-design such fabrication recipes by using a physics-based simulator of ion-matter interactions as a tool. Given an arbitrary depth profile of implanted ions or vacancies, the agent selects the ion species, energies, incident angles, and target material layers; writes, runs, and interprets simulations; and iteratively refines the recipe until the simulated profile matches the target, with minimal human input. Our work demonstrates physics-guided agentic inverse design as a practical approach to making the spatial structure of materials a programmable variable, opening new opportunities to explore emergent physical phenomena and functional phases of matter.

title: Collective Modes of Fractional States Beyond Landau Levels
abstract: Collective modes provide a powerful probe into the properties and stability of topologically ordered and strongly interacting phases of matter, such as fractional quantum Hall states. Yet, the description of fractional-state excitations away from the Landau-level limit remains a formidable challenge. We develop a framework for describing collective excitations in the strong-coupling regime of coupled-wire constructions and show that they emerge as solitons and breathers of effective sine-Gordon theories. This approach provides a systematic route to studying collective modes in a broad class of fractional states. Applied to a coupled-wire construction of the fractional quantum Hall effect, the framework captures key features of the magnetoroton branch. It naturally extends to fractional Chern insulators, demonstrating that magnetoroton-like collective modes persist well beyond the Landau-level limit. We find that the magnetoroton gap increases as the Fubini-Study metric approaches the ideal (trace-condition) limit, highlighting the important role of quantum geometry in the stability of fractionalized phases and their collective excitations. The same trend favors the stability of the long-wavelength quadrupolar mode associated with the chiral graviton. Together, these results identify a distinct interplay between fractionalization and quantum geometry, and provide an analytical framework for studies of collective excitations in fractional topological matter.

title: Lattice spin systems coupled to a compact U(1) gauge field with negative gauge coupling favoring frustration
abstract: We investigate the phase diagram and nature of the phase transitions of three-dimensional compact lattice Abelian Higgs models with negative gauge coupling. These models describe multicomponent complex scalar fields coupled to a compact U(1) gauge field. Negative gauge coupling favors frustrated plaquette configurations, competing with the tendency of the matter ferromagnetic-like interaction to suppress frustration. Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling analyses of models with one- and two-component scalar fields of unit charge reveal a substantially richer phase structure than at nonnegative gauge coupling. For two components, the O(3) transition line associated with gauge-invariant bilinear ordering extends into the negative-coupling region, and turns into a first-order transition line with decreasing $K$, toward the fully-frustrated $K\to -\infty$ limit. An analogous first-order transition line is also found for the one-component scalar matter with negative gauge coupling. Both one- and two-component models exhibit two additional continuous transition lines at sufficiently large matter coupling. Their energy-cumulant scaling is consistent with three-dimensional Ising and XY critical exponents, suggesting topological transitions in the $\mathbb Z_2$ and XY gauge universality classes, respectively. These results uncover additional phases generated by the competition between matter ordering and dynamical gauge frustration, whose physical characterization remains an open question.

title: Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz for the Toda chain from inverse scattering transform
abstract: The Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) procedure developed by Yang-Yang provides the free energy functional to be minimized via a variational problem. Their result not only gives the correct thermodynamics, but it also sets the framework for Generalized Hydrodynamics. Originally developed for quantum systems, this procedure has been recently successfully applied to (integrable) classical particle systems. However, this has never been done for classical field theories: no classical derivation has consistently accounted for solitons, breathers, radiation (dispersive modes), and their mutual interactions. We here derive the TBA equations for the Toda chain directly from its inverse scattering transform. This results in solitonic modes interacting with radiation, extending the soliton gas picture. We provide numerical verification of our equations against well established TBA equations in terms of particle modes. We expect the same procedure should apply to KdV, and pure radiative models as defocusing NLS and Sinh-Gordon, while we discuss current limitations in other models such as focusing NLS (and Ablowitz-Ladik) and Sine-Gordon.

title: Stationary distribution of active Brownian particles in a bounded domain
abstract: Self-propelled particles such as swimming micro-organisms often accumulate at boundaries. Active Brownian particles (ABPs), that is, particles moving at constant speed with an orientation undergoing rotational diffusion, provide a simple model. ABPs have a finite probability to be on the boundary. Their probability density therefore includes both regular bulk and singular boundary components. Exchanges between these represent capture at the boundary and re-entry into the bulk. We examine the distribution of ABPs in the stationary regime. We first obtain a similarity solution that describes the probability density near the turning points, where orientation is tangential to the boundary and particles re-enter the bulk. This shows that the bulk density is singular and the boundary density is non-differentiable. We then add spatial diffusion to the ABP model and investigate the limit $\eps \to 0$ of small spatial diffusivity. We use matched asymptotics to describe the regularising effect of a finite $\eps$, focusing on the vicinity of the turning points. We assess our predictions against numerical simulations using both lattice Markov chain and finite-element discretisations.

title: Liouvillian Kramers Degeneracy
abstract: The Kramers theorem generally guarantees the spectral degeneracy of time-reversal-invariant Hamiltonian operators with half-integer spin, underlying a variety of physical phenomena. Despite its fundamental significance, the Kramers degeneracy has been argued to be absent in Liouvillian superoperators acting on mixed states because of the double structure of the Hilbert space. Here, we instead demonstrate that the interplay of time-reversal symmetry$^†$ and parity symmetry enforces the Kramers degeneracy in Liouvillians. We explicitly construct dissipative many-body models of interacting fermions and spins exhibiting the Kramers degeneracy and show that their complex spectral statistics follow those of non-Hermitian random matrices in the corresponding symplectic symmetry classes. Of the three fundamental universality classes of non-Hermitian random matrices, the symplectic class has never been realized in symmetry-resolved many-body Liouvillians. Our constructions provide its explicit realizations and spectral signatures of nonintegrability in symplectic open quantum systems.

title: Thermodynamically consistent thixotropic viscoelastic modeling of human blood from a conformational free energy
abstract: Structural thixotropic viscoelastic models describe the rheology of human blood accurately, but their structural kinetics are postulated, so their compatibility with the second law of thermodynamics is not guaranteed. We present ROUGE (ROUleaux model Guided by free Energy), a tensorial model of blood that describes the deformation of individual red blood cells and of rouleaux with two conformation tensors, and the degree of aggregation with a scalar variable. A single postulated Helmholtz free energy determines the stress, the relaxation of all three variables, and the entropy generation, so the model satisfies the second law in any flow. To build it, we extend a simplified formulation of nonequilibrium thermodynamics, which accounts for conformational energy and entropy, to microstructures described by several structural variables of different kinds. The coupling between aggregation and rouleaux deformation is motivated by the Langmuir adsorption of fibrinogen and is restricted so that the quiescent, fully aggregated state is the stable minimum of the free energy. Fits to published data for step-ups and step-downs in shear rate show that the fibrinogen binding sites remain far from saturation, so that the free energy has no adjustable parameters. They also show that rouleaux breakdown requires no empirical shear-activation term: the structure is destroyed in proportion to the work done by the flow on the aggregates, and a single structural time produces both breakdown within seconds and an algebraic recovery over tens of seconds. The resulting model has five well-determined parameters, and its fitted solvent viscosity coincides with that of plasma.

title: Maximum entropy explanation for the ubiquity of power-law mechanical responses
abstract: The ubiquitous power-law relaxation emerges from complex mechanical systems with a vast number of interacting exponential responses. Here we demonstrate that power-law responses satisfy a maximum entropy criterion, regulating the individual contributions under partial knowledge. This leads to a prediction that frequency range of validity decreases with power-law exponent, a property which is confirmed for some biological materials. The close relation with the fractional standard linear solid also leads to an incorporation of the equally ubiquitous stretched exponential behavior.

title: Energy-Resolved Cross-Correlation of THz Field Emission of Electrons from a Metal Nanotip
abstract: Intense THz pulses, combined with the lightning-rod field enhancement at metal nanotips, can drive field emission of keV-energy, femtosecond-duration electron bunches, yet the dynamics governing this emission remain largely unexplored. Here we probe these dynamics by cross-correlating the energy-resolved emission driven by two independently generated single-cycle THz pulses focused onto a tungsten nanotip, scanning their relative delay over 160 ps. At total bunch charges approaching $10^6$ e$^-$, the delay-energy emission map near zero delay reveals electrons accelerated up to 2.1 keV, with a cross-correlation width of ~210 fs full width at half maximum at the highest energies. Apart from replicas caused by optical reflections in the setup, no emission echoes are observed over the full delay range, ruling out long-lived antenna resonances such as Sommerfeld-wave reflections along the tip shaft. A 1D Fowler-Nordheim model incorporating a low-$Q$, sub-picosecond antenna response for the local field enhancement reproduces the peak electron energies and the asymmetry of the delay-energy map. Our results indicate that each THz pulse produces a single, isolated electron burst, and that energy filtering can select its shortest, highest-energy component.

title: Dynamical Phonon Anharmonicity Drives Charge-Density-Wave Softening and Electronic Quasiparticle Decoherence in Monolayer 1H-NbSe2
abstract: Charge-density-wave (CDW) instabilities in two-dimensional materials are governed by strongly anharmonic soft phonons, whose dynamical behavior remains poorly understood beyond the statically renormalized vibrations. Here, using monolayer 1H-NbSe2, we investigate how frequency-dependent three- and four-phonon interactions reshape phonon spectral functions and influence electronic excitations. We find that three-phonon interactions induce substantial dynamical softening of CDW modes, increasing the estimated transition temperature relative to static self-consistent phonon theory. Four-phonon interactions further promote such dynamical softening and enhance spectral broadening, producing non-Lorentzian lineshapes that challenge the quasiparticle picture. Incorporating dynamically renormalized phonon frequencies and electron-phonon coupling into Fan-Migdal electron self-energy calculations reveals enhanced electronic kinks, satellite features, and momentum-dependent quasiparticle decoherence, driven by the strong momentum dependence of the electron-phonon coupling matrix elements. These findings establish dynamical anharmonicity as a critical link between soft-mode lattice fluctuations and electronic spectral signatures, providing insights into coupled lattice-electron dynamics in two-dimensional quantum materials.

title: Continuum Dirac Theory and Nonlinear Extensions of a Chain of Alternating non-linear springs: an SSH version of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou model
abstract: A mechanical version of the SSH model, made of equal masses joined by two alternating non-linear springs is studied in the continuum limit. Such a non-linear dimerized mechanical chain generates a nonlinear, dispersive, two-field hyperbolic system of Boussinesq type of differential equations, describing coupled acoustic and gapped optical fields. The corresponding Lagrangian density is found, revealing that the acoustic and optical degrees of freedom are coupled through a structure that is formally analogous to a synthetic spin-orbit coupling, where the spatial motion is locked to the internal sublattice degree of freedom. An emergent non-Abelian Berry connection term also appears. Some particular solitary-wave solutions are found using variational theory, as the effective optical field obeys an undamped and unforced cubic-quintic Duffing equation. Near the Brillouin-zone edge, the system becomes a nonlinear Dirac field theory of the Soler type, providing a direct mechanical realization of interacting relativistic solitons. By factoring out fast spatial oscillations, an effective Jackiw-Rebbi Hamiltonian is obtained, with topological zero modes at domain walls. These modes are akin to the electronic flat bands in moire graphene systems associated with superconductivity and charge fractionalization. Finally, we discuss the mechanical rigidity transition and its effects on the fields as the system evolves toward the fully dimerized limit, in which the zero modes are floppy modes.

title: Chirality rules for optical vortices in rhombohedral graphene multilayers
abstract: Optical zeros are momenta where the interband dipole vanishes. The dipole phase winds around each of them by an integer, so they are vortices of the resonant optical response with a conserved charge. We show that in rhombohedral graphene multilayers one integer, the stacking chirality $N$, fixes their constellation near the $K$ valley: the total charge per linear polarization is $N-1$ and is conserved under trigonal warping and interlayer bias; for $N\ge3$ the $K$ point stays an exact optical zero, the Bernal bilayer being the only exception; warping places the remaining charge on satellites whose radii scale linearly with the warping; and the charge pinned at $K$ is bias independent for $N\ge4$. A quantized interband character counts the enclosed charge as an integer staircase with steps at these radii, and an interlayer bias drives a satellite through the protected $K$ vortex in the trilayer. The rules survive the remote hoppings of the full tight-binding model and, being integer charges, the corrections that reshape the bands. The same integer sets the magnitude of the response: the band-edge shift current grows linearly with $N$.
summary:
1. 作者结合低能路径展开与全紧束缚计算，研究偏置菱方N层石墨烯中堆垛手性对带间偶极零点及位移电流的约束。
2. 三角翘曲重排涡旋而保持每种线偏振在K谷附近的总绕数±(N−1)，且U=0.05 eV时2—6层带边位移电流峰近似正比于N。
3. 这为层数调控光电响应提供理论依据，但实验比较宜用带边积分谱重而非展宽敏感的峰值，并评估激子与无序修正。

title: Glauber dynamics of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model: a dynamical cavity method
abstract: We present a closed theory, exact in the $N\to\infty$ limit, of the equilibrium spin correlations of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model evolving with Glauber dynamics, above and at the transition temperature $T_c$. The derivation uses a dynamic cavity approach: in the evolution equation for the selected spin the other spins are represented by a fluctuating field. The influence of the selected spin on this field is included at the linear response level; it is given as a sum of the spin's past flips weighted by the correlations of the unperturbed fluctuating field. The self-consistency condition relates the time-dependent correlations of the selected spin and those of the fluctuating field. The theory predicts a $(T-T_c)^{-2}$ divergence of the relaxation time upon approaching the transition and an $At^{-1/2}$ decay of spin correlations at $T_c$. A numerical solution of the theory gives the amplitude, $A=0.964\pm 0.007$. The theoretical predictions are in excellent agreement with Glauber dynamics computer simulations.
summary:
1. 针对零场SK自旋玻璃在T≥T_c的平衡弛豫，作者用动力学空腔法将Glauber演化约化为高斯场与历史反作用场驱动的自洽单自旋过程。
2. 理论给出最慢弛豫时间τ∝(T−T_c)^{-2}及临界关联C(t)∼At^{-1/2}，数值求得A=0.964±0.007，纠正旧近似的振幅低估，且关联曲线与外推模拟吻合。
3. 该框架有望推广至低温老化，但需另求双时响应，且热力学极限精确性所依赖的高斯空腔场与线性响应假设尚未在本模型中严格证明。

title: greenWTE: Frequency-domain solver for the phonon Wigner Transport Equation with arbitrary heating using Green's functions
abstract: Heat transport in solids is usually described in a phenomenological way via Fourier's law. However, at small time and length scales in low thermal conductivity materials, a microscopic description is needed. This is traditionally done by invoking the phonon Boltzmann Transport Equation (BTE), which has been successful in describing transport in high thermal conductivity materials. Recently, a generalization of the BTE, the Wigner Transport Equation, was developed to be able to microscopically describe transport in low thermal conductivity materials by taking into account not only phonon scattering processes but also phonon tunneling processes, so-called coherences. We present a Python package that solves the Wigner Transport Equation (WTE) in spatial and temporal Fourier space for arbitrary source terms, thereby enabling the study of heat transport at small space and time scales. This allows one to compute both static and dynamic thermal conductivities from bulk to nanoscale. Beyond that, it can be used to study the response of phonon systems in materials to arbitrary heat sources.
summary:
1. 针对低热导固体短时短程的非扩散传热，作者开发Python程序greenWTE，在时空傅里叶域求解包含声子散射与相干的维格纳输运方程。
2. 程序支持任意热源及声子模式选择性加热，以可复用的格林函数或逐源迭代法计算热流及尺度、频率依赖的热导率。
3. 该工具可用于泵浦—探测和瞬态热光栅的微观建模，但文中未展示数值算例或实验验证。

title: Orbital Hall effect from the Wannier function approach
abstract: Using the Wannier function approach, we develop a gauge-covariant formalism for the orbital angular momentum (OAM) operator and the orbital Hall conductivity (OHC). The Wannier function formulation resolves the position-operator ambiguity inherent to Bloch states, providing a transparent and rigorous theory of orbital transport. Our formalism is validated through a finite-lattice calculation of the Haldane model, where the OAM operator is evaluated exactly from its real-space definition. Our results are also relevant to other orbital phenomena in solids such as the orbital Edelstein effect, orbital torque generation, and the like, where the OAM plays a crucial role.
summary:
1. 针对布洛赫态位置算符的歧义，作者在Wannier表象推导规范协变的轨道角动量算符，并以久保线性响应构建轨道霍尔电导理论。
2. 公式重现60×60周期Haldane晶格的实空间角动量与电导计算，包含部分既有表达式遗漏的非零带间角动量项。
3. 该框架适用于金属与绝缘体，有望支撑轨道Edelstein效应和轨道力矩计算，但数值检验限于模型，电导仍受有限动量采样限制。

title: Anomalous Hall Response and Real-Space Current Correlations in Rhombohedral Graphene
abstract: We investigate the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and magnetization observed in rhombohedral graphene through real-space calculations which lead to new insights. Our calculations reveal no equilibrium loop currents of the type associated with the Haldane model of a quantum anomalous Hall insulator. Instead, the AHE arises in this instance from interference between electronic paths forming oriented closed Wilson loops of current operators in the presence of valley polarization. We show some examples of these Wilson loops. Using the fact that the added-carrier charge density resides dominantly in the top and bottom layers, we develop a real-space expansion of the surface Hamiltonian that reproduces the Hall response of the full model with good accuracy. We also predict that a smooth local potential induces equilibrium circulating currents whose strength depends on both Berry curvature and the orbital moments of states at the Fermi surface.
summary:
1. 作者用八轨道紧束缚模型的实空间电流关联与表面投影，研究ABCA四层石墨烯谷极化态的反常霍尔效应是否需要平衡环流。
2. 均匀态无平衡键电流，霍尔响应源于闭合电流关联中的路径干涉；二阶表面展开重构波函数后，所选参数下的霍尔电导与完整八带结果仅差0.44%。
3. 预测平滑局域势可诱发依赖贝里曲率及费米面轨道磁矩的平衡环流，或可用磁成像检验，但缺陷附近的极化变化仍待自洽处理。

title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
abstract: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at this https URL .
summary:
1. 针对晶格费米子与自旋的低能态和动力学，作者开发JAX开源库LaQX，以函数接口整合神经波函数、蒙特卡洛采样和优化。
2. 6×6受挫海森堡基准的每格点能量较精确对角化高约3×10⁻⁶J₁，同一框架在12×8 Hofstadter体系给出每磁通量子约1/3粒子的泵浦。
3. 可复用接口为新模型的低能谱与非平衡研究提供基础，但有限尺寸基准尚不能保证更大体系的精度，投影仍受固定节点近似限制。

title: Altermagnetism-induced higher-order topological Dirac semimetals in two-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems
abstract: We propose an altermagnetism-induced route to a two-dimensional higher-order topological Dirac semimetal in a trilayer nonsymmorphic Dirac system. Interlayer hybridization preserves the nonsymmorphic bulk Dirac crossings and generates helical edge states in the trilayer phase. Introducing outer-layer $d$-wave altermagnetic order gaps the helical edge states, while only the symmetry-protected Dirac crossing at high-symmetry point $M$ remains gapless. The resulting phase hosts a surviving bulk Dirac point, gapped edge spectra, and corner states. An exact layer-space decomposition further reveals that these features arise from the coexistence of a gapless Dirac sector and a gapped $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological sector. Our results establish altermagnetism as an effective mechanism for engineering higher-order topological Dirac semimetals in two-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems.
summary:
1. 为探明体狄拉克点与角态如何共存，作者以能谱计算和层空间精确分解研究外层含d波交错磁序的二维非对称型三层紧束缚模型。
2. 无隙狄拉克扇区与有隙拓扑扇区共存，磁序使X、Y点及螺旋边缘开隙而保留M点交叉，并通过相邻边缘质量反号产生四个零能角态。
3. 该相在所测适度层参数不对称下仍稳定，但外层反号在位势可破坏角态局域性，具体材料实现仍待探索。

title: TT-SCHA for Thermodynamics of Binary Alloys
abstract: The free energy of a crystal is an integral over the positions of all its atoms, in 3N dimensions. We evaluate it without random sampling for the ordered alloys B2 NiAl and gamma-TiAl with embedded-atom potentials, using a self-consistent harmonic approximation (SCHA) corrected to third order in temperature, calculated via thermal averages of tensor-train (TT) integrals built from one atom and its neighbors, which we call TT-SCHA. The result is for an infinite crystal without sampling error; its numerical error is set by the starting pivots of the interpolation (up to 9 MPa in the pressure, reduced by averaging three runs; SM Table S26). Against the molecular dynamics of 65,536 atoms (Frenkel-Ladd free energy at 600 K, integrated energy above), TT-SCHA free energy agrees to 0.13 meV per atom at 600-1000 K, using 420-500 times fewer core-seconds for one run. At zero pressure, results agree with published calculations that use the same embedded-atom potential: the published elastic constants of gamma-TiAl (to 1 GPa, by a static lattice calculation) and its thermal expansion from Monte Carlo sampling (to 0.012 percentage points).
summary:
1. 为计算有序合金的非谐自由能，作者在B2-NiAl和γ-TiAl的嵌入原子势模型中，将局域张量列积分、自洽谐近似及至T³阶的累积量展开结合。
2. 在600–1000 K范围内，三次运行均值与65536原子分子动力学参考的自由能最大偏差约0.13 meV/原子，合计核时约为参考计算的1/140–1/165。
3. 该方法可独立核验采样自由能，但目前仅验证两种经典势，单势阱假设不涵盖熔化与相变，高温精度仍受截断及插值枢轴误差限制。

title: Topology Does Not Determine Defect Mobility in Active Polar Matter
abstract: Topological defects are commonly characterized by their charge, although defects with the same charge can have different internal morphologies. We study the annihilation of isolated $\pm1$ defect pairs in a two-dimensional compressible Toner--Tu model, varying the morphology of the $+1$ defect while keeping the initial charges and separation fixed. Activity produces a morphology-dependent mobility asymmetry: reversing the radial orientation of an aster reverses which defect travels farther, and asters show the strongest response. An early-time analysis reveals that the initial morphology selects distinct density modes whose gradients subsequently feed back on the polarization. Consistently, removing the density-gradient coupling strongly suppresses the asymmetry. These results establish defect morphology, in addition to topological charge, as a dynamical variable governing defect-pair motion in active polar matter.
summary:
1. 作者在二维可压缩Toner–Tu模型中固定±1缺陷对初距、改变+1纹理，结合数值模拟与短时展开检验形态对湮灭动力学的影响。
2. 活性引发的迁移不对称以星状纹理最强，反转其初始径向取向使迁移更远者在正负缺陷间互换；去除密度梯度耦合显著抑制差异，支持密度—极化反馈机制。
3. 形态应纳入极性活性物质的缺陷动力学描述，但其对多缺陷体系或非受限细胞单层中缺陷寿命与湮灭路径的影响仍待检验。

title: Annealing-Induced Structural and Optical Evolution of Ion-Beam-Sputtered Ta2O5 Films for High-Power Laser Applications
abstract: Tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) thin films deposited by ion beam sputtering (IBS) are essential components in high-power laser systems, where post-deposition annealing is routinely used to optimize film quality. In this work, we systematically investigate the structural and optical evolution of IBS-deposited Ta2O5 single layers subjected to post-deposition annealing at temperatures from 400 to 800 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$. The films undergo an amorphous-to-polycrystalline transition between 600 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and 700 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, accompanied by a marked increase in surface roughness. Argon bubbles inherently incorporated during IBS serve as structural markers: their size correlates positively with the surface roughness from the as-deposited to 700 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ but decouples at 800 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, revealing a transition from matrix-relaxation-dominated to surface-diffusion-dominated behavior. Transmittance spectra show a red shift at 400 and 600 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ which can be explained by physical thickness increase. Weak absorption decreases from ~6 ppm in as-deposited films to ~2 ppm at 400-600 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ due to annihilation of oxygen vacancies, rises markedly at 700 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ due to grain-boundary defects and then drops again at 800 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ as grain boundaries relax. We identify 400 $^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ as the optimal annealing window for IBS-deposited Ta2O5 single layers, with the lowest surface roughness and effectively reducing weak absorption while preserving the amorphous phase.
summary:
1. 作者对离子束溅射Ta₂O₅单层膜进行400—800℃空气退火5小时，结合电镜、衍射、原子力显微镜及表面热透镜测量，考察氩泡、晶化与弱吸收的关联。
2. 400℃保持非晶态并将1064 nm吸收由约6 ppm降至约2 ppm，而800℃氩泡继续长大、吸收回落，支持电子缺陷而非气泡主导弱吸收。
3. 400℃兼具低吸收与最低粗糙度，是所测单层膜的优选退火条件，但多层镜适用性及高功率激光损伤性能仍需验证。

title: Interfacial Hole Accumulation Enables Selective Free-Surface Formation in Ge-on-Si
abstract: Electrochemically formed two-dimensional free surfaces (2DFS) decouple Ge epilayers from the misfit-dislocation network at the Ge/Si interface, but the origin of their selectivity has remained unclear. We combine finite-volume current-distribution modelling, including charge-transfer kinetics, with a one-dimensional Poisson analysis of the p-Ge/p+-Si heterojunction. With realistic conductivities, an ohmic description would drive 77% of the anodic current through Ge, whereas hole-limited charge transfer reduces this fraction to 0.07%, independently of the electrolyte conductivity. The valence-band offset accumulates holes on the Ge side up to ~1019 cm--3 within a self-limited nanometric layer, which localizes dissolution at the interface. The model yields design rules for the doping contrast (NSi/NGe ___ 60) and the mesa width (___ 3.6$\lambda$, with $\lambda$ $\approx$ 1.7 $\mu$m).
summary:
1. 为解释Ge/Si界面电化学溶解的选择性，作者结合含电荷转移动力学的有限体积模拟与p-Ge/p⁺-Si结的一维泊松计算。
2. 空穴受限电荷转移将模拟中的Ge侧壁电流占比由欧姆模型的77%降至0.07%，价带偏移诱导的纳米级空穴积累则解释界面优先溶解。
3. 模型给出Si/Ge掺杂比≳60、台面宽度≲3.6λ（λ≈1.7微米）的解耦设计准则，但提高Si掺杂以减薄反应层仍须权衡过度多孔化风险。

title: Why strong spin-orbit coupling does not destabilize the Dirac spin liquid in the Yb delafossites
abstract: The Yb delafossites NaYbSe$_2$, KYbSe$_2$, CsYbSe$_2$ and NaYbO$_2$ are candidates for the U(1) Dirac spin liquid (DSL) of the triangular lattice. Strong spin-orbit coupling gives their exchange an XXZ anisotropy $\Delta$ and bond-dependent couplings $J_{\pm\pm}$, $J_{z\pm}$ that lock the spin frame to the lattice. We show that, within a single layer of a stable Heisenberg DSL, these couplings generate no relevant Lorentz-scalar operator of their own. Inversion at the bond centers removes the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya channel that gaps the kagome DSL, so the locked symmetry forbids a mass, density or current at any order and, assuming continuity, any new monopole term through charge three. Every Lorentz-scalar four-fermion operator induced by spin-orbit coupling shares an SU(4) multiplet, and hence its scaling dimension, with a Heisenberg-allowed one, and the nine non-scalar quartics without such a partner arise only at second order and are irrelevant at large $N$. The Heisenberg DSL itself allows a Lorentz-vector quartic of large-$N$ dimension 2.92, which a stable phase must also render irrelevant. Beyond a single layer, spin-orbit coupling opens an interlayer monopole channel in rhombohedral stacking. If the Heisenberg DSL is instead multicritical, an anisotropy as small as that of KYbSe$_2$ matters only below tens of mK. At the transition to 120$^\circ$ order the anisotropy is relevant, and exact diagonalization indicates that easy-plane anisotropy selects the chiral-Ising class. Existing KYbSe$_2$ neutron data below $J$ do not yet fix the K-point exponent, and gapless out-of-plane spin fluctuations at the K point would test the chiral-Ising selection.
summary:
1. 作者结合QED₃对称性分类与精确对角化，研究镱基铜铁矿型磁体中自旋轨道耦合诱导的交换各向异性能否使狄拉克自旋液体失稳。
2. 单层中，键心反演与锁定对称性排除质量项，新增洛伦兹标量四费米项均与海森堡允许项同属SU(4)多重态，故若海森堡母相稳定便不新增相关标量扰动。
3. 有限团簇结果支持易面各向异性在120°有序转变处选择手征伊辛类，可由K点偏振中子谱检验，但层间单极子隧穿仍可能导致低能失稳。

title: Spin-orbit-locked symmetry and the stability of the triangular Dirac spin liquid in the ytterbium delafossites
abstract: The Yb delafossites NaYbSe$_2$, KYbSe$_2$, CsYbSe$_2$ and NaYbO$_2$ are candidates for the triangular U(1) Dirac spin liquid, QED$_3$ with $N_f=4$, but their exchange is spin-orbit coupled. Under their spin-orbit-locked space group we determine which operators the XXZ anisotropy and the bond-dependent couplings $J_{\pm\pm}$, $J_{z\pm}$ induce, and at what order. Symmetry forbids every Dirac mass, density and current at any order and, assuming adiabatic continuity, any new monopole term through charge three. At linear order the couplings reach only spin-2 members of the quartic multiplets $\mathbf{20}'$ and $\mathbf{84}$, which share their dimensions with Heisenberg-allowed operators. At second order $J_{\pm\pm}$ and $J_{z\pm}$ renormalize the anisotropy through $J_{z\pm}^2-2J_{\pm\pm}^2$, and nine spin-1 quartics without Heisenberg partners appear, irrelevant at $O(1/N)$. A single layer of a stable Heisenberg spin liquid thus acquires no relevant Lorentz-scalar operator from spin-orbit coupling. The Heisenberg liquid itself allows a Lorentz-vector $\mathbf{20}'$ quartic of large-$N$ dimension 2.92, with two-loop $\epsilon$-expansion estimates 2.9-3.5. Rhombohedral stacking adds triplet-monopole tunneling between layers at first order. At the transition to 120$^\circ$ order the anisotropy is relevant, with crossover exponent $y_T\simeq0.74$-1, and exact diagonalization shows that easy-plane anisotropy selects the chiral-Ising class. The out-of-plane spectrum at the K point then stays gapless, and the spin-flip to non-spin-flip ratio grows as $\omega^{-0.56}$ at leading order. Existing KYbSe$_2$ neutron data below $J$ do not fix the K-point exponent. In-plane fields induce a chiral mass and an out-of-plane moment proportional to $\sin3\varphi$, zero along the bonds and canceling between CsYbSe$_2$ layers, which the planar thermal Hall effect can test.
summary:
1. 作者结合零模对称性投影、等变映射与精确对角化，研究镱基铜铁矿型磁体中各向异性交换对三角晶格狄拉克自旋液体稳定性的影响。
2. 锁定对称性在任意阶禁止显式质量，弱各向异性不为原本稳定的海森堡单层新增相关洛伦兹标量，但其本征矢量四费米项维数估计为2.9—3.5，稳定前提仍未确定。
3. 偏振中子可检验易面临界区预言的无隙面外谱及面内／面外谱强度比的ω^{-0.56}标度，后者仅为大N领先阶估计。

title: Spin-Density-Driven Hybrid Spin Splitting in Collinear Compensated Magnets
abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting in collinear compensated magnets is constrained by spin-group symmetry, with distinct alternating and Zeeman-type splitting typically associated with altermagnets and fully compensated ferrimagnets, respectively. From a spin-density perspective, we propose a class of hybrid compensated magnets in which alternating-like and Zeeman-type spin splitting coexist within a single collinear compensated state. Using a minimal two-sector model, we demonstrate that this coexistence arises from competition between directional sublattice dispersion and the sector-dependent energy biases arising from the same structural inequivalence. First-principles calculations provide a proof of concept in a crossed bilayer of unequal-width Janus graphene nanoribbons, where the structurally inequivalent ribbons retain approximately symmetry-related spin-density distributions. The valence and conduction sectors support direction-selective spin transport and energy-selective spin-polarized states, respectively. These results connect the spatial organization of spin density with the electronic response to structural inequivalence, providing a design principle for hybrid spin splitting in compensated magnets.
summary:
1. 作者以双子空间模型和第一性原理计算，探究不等宽Janus石墨烯纳米带交叉双层的共线补偿态能否兼具两类非相对论自旋劈裂。
2. 两层自旋密度保持近似对称关系，而结构偏置与方向性色散在不同子空间竞争，使价带呈约±100 meV的类交替劈裂，高能导带沿所算路径呈同号塞曼型劈裂。
3. 该设计有望整合方向选择输运与能量选择自旋态，但近全极化输运仍是300 K刚性能带近似下的预测，尚待实验验证。

title: Hydrated porous substrates modulate the spatiotemporal dynamics of bacterial turbulence
abstract: Boundary conditions strongly influence bacterial turbulence, motivating the question of how hydrated porous substrates affect near-interface collective motion. We characterize the spatiotemporal dynamics of dilute and dense Escherichia coli suspensions above agar substrates of varying concentrations, with glass serving as a nonporous reference. In dense suspensions shortly after loading, collective in-plane kinetic energy varies nonmonotonically with agar concentration, while individual swimming energy and characteristic spatial scales show comparatively little variation. Over five minutes above agar, the collective flow attenuates strongly, accompanied by shorter spatial correlations, longer temporal correlations, and a greater relative spectral weight at higher wavenumbers. To explore how the porous boundary may contribute to these changes, we extend mean-field kinetic theory (MFKT) to incorporate normal seepage and tangential slip at the interface. Linear stability analysis distinguishes near-interface collective modes from those in the bulk and identifies how fluid-layer thickness and permeability-dependent slip length modify the instability cutoff. The predicted reduction in the associated length scale provides a qualitative interpretation of the smaller flow structures observed over time and at higher agar concentrations. These findings reveal distinct substrate-dependent changes in the intensity, persistence, and spatial organization of near-interface bacterial turbulence.
summary:
1. 作者以玻璃为对照，用光流法比较不同浓度琼脂上方稀、浓大肠杆菌悬液，考察含水多孔边界对近界面湍流的影响。
2. 个体游速变化很小，初始集体动能却在琼脂质量分数约0.7%时达峰，而0.5%琼脂上五分钟内流动显著衰减、相关长度缩短而相关时间延长。
3. 含渗流与滑移的平均场动理学线性分析可定性解释尺度收缩，但未解释动能演化，尚需独立测量液层厚度、渗透率和滑移以检验机制。

title: Small-data physics-informed ML model for magnetic exchange based on chemical composition and structure
abstract: In this paper we propose an ensemble model based on a swarm of dense neural networks, able to predict Heisenberg exchange interactions within less than 1% error. The model uses the inputs of the ab-initio Schrödinger equation, i.e. the compound structure and chemical composition. In this first work, we trained the model on a few compounds of the hexagonal manganite family and were able to infer, with similar accuracy, the J values for other compounds of the same family at randomly chosen geometries, thus showing that we accurately learned the effect of the chemical composition and structure on effective magnetic integrals J.
summary:
1. 为从成分与结构预测磁交换，作者以多参考从头算生成的小数据集训练融合局域几何与SOAP晶体环境描述的全连接网络集成，并在六方锰氧化物中检验。
2. 对未参与训练的LuMnO3，预测相对从头算基准的均方根误差低于标称交换强度的1%，且入选网络均包含离子半径信息。
3. 该方法有望加速自旋哈密顿量参数化，但迁移性仅在同族材料的实验结构附近得到验证，跨材料家族推广仍待检验。

title: Statistical approach of random packing of polydisperse similar hyperspheres: with application to binomial and lognormal size distributions
abstract: This paper addresses the packing fraction of polydisperse similar hyperspheres with a discrete binomial and continuous lognormal particle size distribution. First, a closed form expression is derived of a mix consisting of multiple discrete particles in D-dimensional Euclidean space R^D with small size differences. A recently developed analytical model for binary packings with small size ratio u is used, here applying it to the statistically probable particle pairs in the multi-sized mix. The new model is subsequently applied to discretely sized particles with a binomial number distribution and a constant size ratio u between each subsequent particle size. By taking the limit of u -> 1 and an infinite number of particles sizes, the binomial particle distribution is transformed into a continuous lognormal distribution. The resulting expression for the packing fraction can be solved in closed form, resulting in an original expression for the packing fraction of mixtures of hyperparticles with a lognormal distribution. This explicit expression is governed by the standard deviation, the Euclidean dimension D, and the monosized packing fraction of the considered particle shape. For a number of particle shapes and their packing modes (from looser to denser) the scaled expression is thoroughly compared with data reported in the literature. They concern packed particles with small standard deviations and in Euclidean dimensions D = 2 and 3, and good agreement is found. For large standard deviations the scaled packing fraction approaches a limiting value, which appears not to depend on the Euclidean dimension. Based on the insight, a closed form expression is put forward for the packing fraction that matches the small standard deviation solution, and the large standard deviation asymptote, so covering arbitrary standard deviations, Euclidean dimensions, particle types, and their mode of packing.
summary:
1. 针对粒径分散如何改变相似硬颗粒的随机堆积分数，作者按粒子对概率扩展排除体积模型，并由等比粒径二项分布的连续极限推导对数正态堆积公式。
2. 无拟合参数的弱分散闭式解预言增密正比于对数粒径方差，其归一化预测与二维圆盘及三维多种颗粒的文献数据基本吻合。
3. 衔接窄、宽分布极限的经验插值可扩展预测范围，但高维适用性尚待验证，且须保持与单分散基准相同的压实条件。

title: Critical amplitudes of the Baxter-Wu model from MCPA and Wolff simulations: free-exponent and fixed-exponent fits
abstract: The two-dimensional Baxter-Wu model belongs to the universality class of the four-state Potts model. Exact expressions are available for its energy, specific heat, magnetization, and polarization amplitudes. We use these results as a benchmark for evaluating two simulation algorithms and two approaches to extracting critical amplitudes. Microcanonical population annealing (MCPA) and the sublattice-freezing Wolff algorithm yield highly consistent estimates for the energy and order parameters when applied to lattices of comparable size. According to the exact Joyce series, the local effective exponent does not stabilize at a constant value but instead undergoes a monotonic drift. This behaviour stems from corrections to scaling, which can be expressed as a series in the cube root of the reduced temperature. As a result, these corrections decay relatively slowly, with the leading term being of relative order $|t|^{2/3}$. When performing a fit with a free exponent on an automatically identified plateau, this drift gets incorporated into the estimated exponent, introducing a substantial bias in the derived amplitudes. In contrast, a fit that fixes the exponent to its exact value and explicitly accounts for the analytic correction series delivers a close match to the known exact amplitudes. Using this refined fitting approach, we obtain estimates for the susceptibility amplitudes and the universal amplitude ratios. These values are in good agreement with predictions from form-factor calculations. Additionally, we numerically determine the leading correction coefficient for the polarization.
summary:
1. 作者以二维Baxter–Wu模型的精确结果为基准，利用微正则群体退火与子晶格冻结Wolff簇模拟，检验标度修正对临界振幅提取的影响。
2. 相对阶为|t|^{2/3}的修正导致有效指数漂移，固定精确指数并纳入修正项后，振幅相对参考值的中位偏差由自由指数拟合的17%降至0.37%。
3. 该策略有望推广至四态Potts模型，但须加入对数修正，并以独立重复模拟完善当前主要反映拟合敏感性的误差评估。

title: Nonlinearity-Induced Suppression of Dissipation in Bath-Coupled Floquet Topological Insulators
abstract: Topological insulators can host chiral, disorder-robust edge states that dissipate energy when coupled to an external bath. We show that nonlinear interactions enable all-optical control over edge-state dissipation in a laser-written Floquet topological insulator periodically coupled to a photonic bath. Although moderate nonlinearity enhances dissipation due to mode mixing, increasing the nonlinear strength to an optimal value dramatically suppresses dissipation by forming highly localized traveling edge solitons. These results establish engineered system-bath coupling and nonlinear interactions as a route to suppress dissipation of chiral topological edge transport.
summary:
1. 作者结合数值模拟与实验，在飞秒激光直写、周期耦合光子浴的Floquet拓扑波导阵列中研究克尔非线性能否抑制边缘态耗散。
2. 中等非线性通过模式混合增损，适当增强则形成单向边缘孤子；实验两周期后的浴损耗由线性条件下的18.8%降至9.1%。
3. 这一无增益机制为全光调控拓扑输运提供途径，但零浴损耗仅见于理想模型，无序限制孤子寿命，固有损耗削弱局域化。

title: Stochastic synthesis and degradation of arbitrary diffusive processes
abstract: Target search processes are often carried out by diffusive elements that are introduced and removed at random times, causing fluctuations in the number of searchers in the system over time. For instance, proteins are synthesized and degraded stochastically in the cell, and susceptible to react with specific binding sites during their lifetime. Here we derive the density profile generated by non-interacting particles subject to stochastic synthesis and degradation (SSD) at constant rates, given a source location and an arbitrary propagator for the single, non-degrading particle. We also study the first-passage properties of these many-searcher processes, which can be deduced from the knowledge of the first-passage time distribution of a single particle. We analyse the behaviours of the characteristic reaction time and of the mean first-passage time in the limits of small and large rates. Taking into account the costs associated with synthesis leads to the existence of an optimal synthesis rate. We further generalise these results to bursty synthesis, when production events involve more than one particle at a time, as often observed in cell biology. The mean first-passage time in these situations can be significantly reduced at low synthesis or large degradation rates, as it is divided by the mean burst size in these regimes. The results presented here are applied to one-dimensional Brownian searches. Some general connections between SSD and resetting processes are pointed out as well as important differences, since SSD is associated with a distinct queueing protocol.
summary:
1. 作者用更新理论研究随机生成与降解如何影响独立粒子的靶标搜索，在恒定速率下由无降解单粒子的传播子和首达分布求得密度及集体首达统计。
2. 固定生成事件率时，高降解率极限下突发生成的平均首达时间与平均批量成反比，但初始无粒子且平均生成通量相同时，逐粒生成不慢于突发生成。
3. 半直线布朗模型计入生成成本后存在有限最优生成率，可为资源受限的分子搜索提供基准，而相互作用及非恒定速率情形仍待拓展。

title: Rotating two-dimensional Bose--Einstein condensates in power-law traps: collapse, Thomas--Fermi scaling, and the inverse-square endpoint
abstract: In two dimensions, the kinetic and contact energies scale identically under dilation, a trap $V=r^s/s$ as $\lambda^{-s}$. We follow this balance through the power-law family $-2\le s\le4$, $s\neq0$, for both signs of the coupling $g$, with rotation, using scaling bounds, radial solutions, Bogoliubov spectra, and two-dimensional imaginary-time states. Attraction collapses the cloud at the Townes coupling $g_{*}$ in every trap, with width $\ell\propto\delta^{1/(s+2)}$, $\delta=1-|g|/g_{*}$; repulsion spreads it to a Thomas--Fermi (TF) radius $\propto g^{1/(s+2)}$. A rotating collapse leaves the axis once the rotation frequency $\Omega$ exceeds its dipole frequency, which softens only for $s>2$; in a quartic trap this happens at $\delta\simeq0.32\,\Omega^6$, within $3\%$ of the Bogoliubov threshold; it then collapses on the minimum ring of the rotating-frame potential, which also empties a repulsive TF cloud at $\Omega=(3g/\pi)^{1/6}$. For repulsive vortex states the TF energy error splits exactly into a density-gradient and a flow part of comparable or larger size. At $s=-2$ only the cutoff sets a length: the energy is exactly covariant with it, the condensate falls to the center for both signs, and repulsion leaves a halo of density $\propto1/(gr^2)$ whose extent grows exponentially with $g$. Near collapse, split-step imaginary time has a first-order stationary bias invisible to residual tests.
summary:
1. 作者结合伸缩分析、径向求解、玻戈留波夫谱与虚时演化，研究二维幂律阱中相互作用和旋转对凝聚体尺度及坍缩的影响。
2. 四次阱中转频超过偶极频率时居中态离轴能量失稳，阈值估计与谱计算相差不足3%；逆平方端点强排斥仍不能阻止落心，却形成密度呈r⁻²、尺度随耦合指数增长的晕。
3. 这些零温平均场预测可通过偶极振荡与密度测量检验，但晕的扩展受有限势程和二维条件限制，离轴坍缩的实时动力学仍待研究。

title: Real-Space renormalization for the drawups and drawdowns of stochastic trajectories: universality classes for diffusion processes and random walks via the scale function
abstract: For one-dimensional diffusion processes with arbitrary diffusion coefficient $D(x)$ and Ito force $F_I(x)$, we analyze the statistical properties of the renormalized trajectories at scale $\Gamma$, where one keeps only the alternating sequence of local minima and local maxima that are separated by drawups and drawdowns of amplitude bigger than $\Gamma$. The elementary RG-step between $\Gamma$ and $\Gamma+d \Gamma$ thus amounts to eliminate the drawups and drawdowns of amplitude $\Gamma$, a real-space-RG-procedure that is well-known for Brownian trajectories in the context of the Strong-Disorder-RG approach applied to the disorder landscape of random models. The main result is that the universality classes are determined by the scale function $s(x)$ satisfying $D(x) s''(x)+F_I(x) s'(x)=0$ that governs the exit probabilities from an interval : all the diffusions sharing the same scale function $s(x)$ have the same statistics of renormalized trajectories, even if their initial microscopic trajectories are completely different. The simplest universality classes for diffusions on the whole line $x \in ]-\infty,+\infty[$ and on the half-line $x \in ]0,+\infty[$ are illustrated with several examples of processes, with or without steady states: Cauchy, Student, Bessel, Fisher-Snedecor, Geometric Brownian. This framework concerning diffusion processes is then adapted to discrete-time and to continuous-time random walks on the one-dimensional lattice with arbitrary nearest-neighbor jump probabilities or rates.
summary:
1. 作者结合区间退出概率与实空间重整化，推导任意漂移和扩散系数的一维扩散在幅度阈值Γ下的交替极值统计。
2. 固定边界条件后，极值序列分布仅由尺度函数决定，布朗运动与柯西稳态扩散同属s(x)=x类，两者连接段幅度超出Γ的部分均呈均值Γ的指数分布。
3. 该框架已推广至一维最近邻格点游走，但极值间历时还依赖速度测度，因此空间普适性不保证动力学等价。

title: Single-anchor Delta-learning with the cluster Gutzwiller approximation: predicting phase boundaries of strongly correlated bosons in optical lattices
abstract: The cluster Gutzwiller method is widely used to study strongly correlated bosonic systems in optical lattices because it explicitly treats quantum fluctuations within a cluster. However, its computational cost grows exponentially with the cluster size, making large-cluster phase diagrams computationally expensive. To reduce this cost, we recently introduced Delta-learning into cluster Gutzwiller calculations and proposed multipoint regression Delta-learning (MPR-Delta), which learns the difference between small- and large-cluster results from four high-cost critical points of the target cluster and thereby predicts the complete target phase boundary. For sufficiently large target clusters, however, even computing one critical point on the phase boundary is already expensive, so obtaining four such points remains highly costly. A natural question then arises: can the complete target phase boundary be predicted with fewer high-cost critical points of the target cluster? To address this question, we propose single-anchor Delta-learning (SA-Delta), which requires only a single high-cost critical point of the target cluster to reconstruct the complete target phase boundary, thereby greatly reducing the computational cost. We test this framework on several classes of Bose-Hubbard models and find that, in the cases considered, it achieves lower reconstruction errors with fewer high-cost points than MPR-Delta. The combination of SA-Delta with the cluster Gutzwiller approximation thus provides an efficient framework for studying phase transitions of strongly correlated bosonic systems in complex optical lattices, and may be extended to more complex quantum many-body systems.
summary:
1. 为低成本预测光晶格强关联玻色子的相界，作者在团簇Gutzwiller框架中提出单锚点Δ学习，以两条小团簇相界之差确定修正形状，再用每条目标相界的一个临界点标定幅度。
2. 四类Bose–Hubbard模型测试中，相对目标团簇结果的平均绝对百分比误差为0.014%–2.858%，较完整团簇计算加速约31–50倍。
3. 热力学外推总体接近已有量子蒙特卡罗基准，但部分瓣尖仍有偏差，向更大团簇推广仍需检验修正形状近似不变的假设。

title: Field-free transverse response in altermagnet and topological insulator heterojunctions
abstract: We theoretically investigate the transport properties of a topological insulator (TI) connected to two-dimensional altermagnetic (AM) leads in the absence of an external magnetic field. Exploiting the intrinsic time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets, we report the emergence of a field-free transverse differential conductivity in the resulting AM-TI-AM heterostructure. Our analysis reveals that this transverse response is highly sensitive to the orientation of the Néel vector: a finite transverse conductivity manifests when the Néel vector possesses an out-of-plane component, whereas it strictly vanishes for in-plane orientations ($\theta = \pi/2$) under symmetric chemical potentials ($\mu_t = \mu_b$) due to the restoration of symmetry between the $k_y$ and $-k_y$ momentum channels. Conversely, when asymmetric chemical potentials are applied ($\mu_t \neq \mu_b$), this symmetry is broken, yielding a finite transverse response even for an in-plane Néel vector. Furthermore, we demonstrate that while the longitudinal differential conductivity exhibits Fabry-Pérot-type oscillations as a function of the TI's chemical potential, the transverse conductivity displays a distinct antisymmetric dependence. Notably, the oscillatory behavior of the longitudinal conductivity persists even at finite temperatures. Spatially, the transverse current contribution decays exponentially with position inside the TI region. We also find that both the longitudinal and transverse differential conductivity exhibit periodic oscillations with the junction parameter $\chi_t=\chi_b$. These findings provide a fundamental understanding of field-free transverse responses in spin-momentum locked boundary states, highlighting the potential of AM-TI heterojunctions for next-generation spintronic applications.
summary:
1. 作者以散射理论和电流守恒边界条件研究二维交错磁引线夹持的拓扑绝缘体，探究无外磁场下局域横向电流的产生条件。
2. 计算预言面外奈尔取向可诱发非零局域横向微分电导率；上下表面等化学势时面内响应因对称性抵消，而化学势失配可恢复响应。
3. 局域霍尔电压测量有望检验这一预测，但模型忽略上下表面杂化及侧表面输运，适用性受样品厚度条件限制。

title: Torsion, valley holonomy, and Berry phases of quasiparticles encircling dislocations and defect complexes in graphene
abstract: We investigate the geometric phase acquired by low-energy quasiparticles encircling defects in graphene. Following Anandan, this phase is the holonomy of the Poincare connection; its translational part couples momentum to torsion, giving $P_a\int T^a$. In the Katanaev-Volovich theory, dislocation torsion is confined to the defect core. For graphene, the relevant momentum is $\hbar(\tau_3\KK+\mathbf q)$. We show that an isolated dislocation yields a topological valley factor $e^{\mp2\pi i/3}$ when its Burgers vector $\bb$ lies outside the $\sqrt3\times\sqrt3$ superlattice, together with a dispersive factor $e^{-i\mathbf q\cdot\bb}$ for every nonzero $\bb$. The topological factor recovers the lattice result of Mesaros et al. as a torsion-flux phase; 4-8 dislocations retain only the dispersive contribution. Composing Volterra elements gives the holonomy of defect complexes. At zero net Frank angle, it depends only on the net Burgers vector. The valley flux obeys a three-coloring rule: pentagons and heptagons contribute according to their Kekule site color, whereas squares and octagons do not. Atomic models confirm that ring content alone does not fix the phase: a 5-8-5 core is invisible as a divacancy or as a dislocation with $|\bb|=\sqrt3a$, but carries flux $\pm1/3$ for $\bb=2\mathbf a_1$. The torsion trace produces no geometric phase: its vector coupling violates time-reversal symmetry, while the allowed axial coupling causes only anisotropic short-range scattering.
summary:
1. 作者用含扭率的庞加莱联络计算石墨烯低能准粒子绕位错及缺陷复合体的几何相位，并以七个原子模型核验。
2. 位错相位含0或±2π/3的谷拓扑项及动量依赖项，净转角为零时复合体的谷通量仅由净柏氏矢量决定并服从三着色规则，环组成不能单独决定通量。
3. 谷通量可望通过扫描隧道显微镜的谷间干涉检验，扭率迹仅致各向异性短程散射而非绕核相位，其散射强度仍需微观计算确定。

title: Optical Ceiling on Polaron Mobility in Disordered Molecular Semiconductors: Lessons from Eumelanin
abstract: Polaron hopping in disordered molecular semiconductors such as eumelanin is set by energetic disorder $\sigma$ and reorganization energy $\lambda$. We show that the reduced polaron absorption band encodes this transport problem. Its value at zero energy fixes the mean hop rate, which bounds the mobility in any dimension. For Gaussian disorder and classical vibrations its centroid is $E_\mathrm{op}=\lambda+(1-c)\sigma^2/k_BT$, its variance obeys the Hush relation, and the bound is the Marcus rate at $\lambda\to E_\mathrm{op}$; a 1D lower bound vanishes at $k_BT^*=(1-c)\sigma^2/\lambda$, read from optics.
summary:
1. 为厘清无序与重组能如何限制极化子迁移率，作者将稀载流子的非绝热近邻跳跃映射为电阻网络，结合解析推导与数值求解建立光谱约束。
2. 约化吸收带的零能值确定平均跳跃率并给出任意维度的迁移率上界，经典振动与高斯无序下，其质心温变还可读出无限链扩散系数归零的温度。
3. 温变光谱有望分辨无序与重组贡献，但真黑素的极化子带尚待指认，且量子振动会将经典一维阈值软化为平滑过渡。

title: Synchronization in one-dimensional arrays of photon condensates
abstract: We investigate the synchronization of coupled photonic Bose-Einstein condensates in dye-filled microcavity arrays, subject to a potential gradient. We show that in the absence of noise the desynchronisation threshold is the result of a dynamical instability. For a two-site system, we analytically derive the maximal potential difference that allows for a synchronized solution as a function of the system parameters and find that it crucially depends on the thermalization rate. For systems with $N$ sites, we find a $N^{-3}$ power law scaling for the critical potential difference. When quantum fluctuations are included, stochastic phase slips broaden the sharp transitions, yet the phase velocity and first order spatial coherence still reliably identify the instability threshold.
summary:
1. 作者结合随机经典场模拟与线性稳定性分析，研究线性势下一维染料填充微腔阵列中光子凝聚体的同步边界。
2. 同步稳态在解消失前发生动力学失稳，强热化且格点数N≥4时，数值所得端到端临界势差近似按N⁻³衰减。
3. 噪声虽展宽转变，一阶空间相干曲线的拐点仍接近无噪声失稳阈值，有望用于实验诊断，但无序势与非均匀泵浦的影响尚待研究。

title: Long-time Brownian dynamics of hard and sticky colloids by geometric projection
abstract: Particle-resolved colloid simulations are often limited by the fastest microscopic time scale retained in the model, which can be many orders of magnitude shorter than the collective process of interest. This is especially restrictive for aggregating colloids, where explicit near-contact potentials force the time integration to resolve the rapid positional relaxation of bonded pairs within narrow attractive wells. Here we introduce an overdamped constraint-based Brownian dynamics method that replaces the time-resolved integration of stiff near-contact forces by a geometric projection step. After each free Brownian update, hard-sphere exclusion, sticky bonds, and hard-wall interactions are enforced by projecting the particle positions onto the constrained configuration set. The method preserves hard-sphere structure and diffusion, recovers the aggregation kinetics of sticky hard spheres, and extends the physical time reached at fixed computational cost by one to two orders of magnitude relative to the explicit-potential simulations tested here. This acceleration makes Brownian-dominated, low-Péclet electrophoretic deposition accessible to particle-scale simulations, revealing a pathway in which the suspension first densifies and only subsequently develops a bonded network. Implemented as a LAMMPS fix, the framework provides a modular route to long-time Brownian simulations of dense constrained colloidal systems.
summary:
1. 为克服近接触快弛豫对胶体长时模拟的限制，作者在过阻尼布朗更新后以几何投影统一施加硬球排斥、不可逆黏结和硬壁约束。
2. 该方法复现所测硬球结构、扩散及短程不可逆聚集动力学，相较测试的显式势模拟，同等成本下可达物理时间增加一至两个数量级。
3. Pe=1的电泳沉积模拟呈现先致密化后成网的路径，支持进一步研究低场沉积，但流体动力学耦合与可逆接触仍待引入。

title: Ferron polariton Hall effect: Deflecting optically rectified polarization with magnetic fields
abstract: Ferrons are elementary excitations of ferroelectric order that can propagate and transport polarization when excited with light. Here, we show theoretically that ferron polaritons exhibit a Hall effect: an applied magnetic field generates polarization transport perpendicular to the propagation direction of a ferron polariton excited by an incident terahertz pulse. We demonstrate this effect for the example of ferroelectric SnTe using first-principles calculations and a microscopic theory of the phonon-polariton current. The direction and magnitude of the transverse polarization transport can be controlled by the polarization of the terahertz pulse and the applied magnetic field. Our results establish a route toward light-controlled directional transport of electric polarization in ferroelectrics.
summary:
1. 作者结合第一性原理与含带间相干的输运理论，研究低温铁电SnTe中太赫兹激发的声子极化激元如何在磁场下横向输运整流净极化。
2. 横向极化流最低阶正比于B_xB_z且可随光偏振转向，假定声子磁矩为1μ_B、取B_z=6T和B_x=1.68T时，预测霍尔角约10⁻³—10⁻²。
3. 该预测可用空间分辨泵浦探测结合二次谐波测量检验，实际横向位移仍依赖声子磁矩与阻尼，尚待实验确认。

title: Designing tunable hyperuniformity in random organization through nonlocal noise
abstract: Hyperuniform fluids suppress density fluctuations at large length scales, but microscopic protocols for designing their asymptotic scaling remain limited. Here we show how effective driving noise generated by particle dynamics can select the hyperuniform exponent while preserving ordinary diffusion and pairwise center-of-mass conservation of the organized particles. We establish this connection through two protocols based on biased random organization (BRO). First, a two-dimensional BRO layer is nonreciprocally coupled to a three-dimensional Brownian gas through density-dependent kick amplitudes. Bulk density fluctuations generate spatially nonlocal noise with a $q^3$ power spectrum in the adiabatic limit, producing $S(q\to0)\sim q^1$. Second, we introduce reciprocal kicks whose lengths follow a Pareto-like distribution, $P(\ell)\sim\ell^{-1-b}$. For $2<b<4$, the finite second moment supports ordinary diffusion, while the divergent fourth moment changes the long-wavelength noise spectrum to $q^b$. The corresponding fluctuating density field theory predicts continuously tunable hyperuniform scaling, $S(q\to0)\sim q^{b-2}$, supported by particle simulations. Together, these results connect targeted hyperuniform scaling to explicit microscopic dynamics and provide a physical basis for designing collective density correlations in nonequilibrium particle systems.
summary:
1. 为调控超均匀指数，作者结合粒子模拟与线性涨落场论，在成对质心守恒的有偏随机组织中引入跨维非互易密度耦合与重尾互易踢动。
2. 三维布朗气体驱动二维层产生S(q)∼q，而重尾踢动P(ℓ)∼ℓ^{-1-b}在2<b<4时给出S(q)∼q^{b-2}，两者均保持普通扩散。
3. 非局域噪声为大尺度密度关联设计提供微观路径，但跨维耦合强度不改变渐近指数，利用时间相关踢动进一步调控仍待探索。

title: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent $SO(6)$ monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing $Z_{2}$ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a $U(1)$ Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.
summary:
1. 为辨明自旋1/2笼目最近邻海森堡反铁磁体的基态，作者构建沿晶格键传递消息的残差神经量子态，在至多300自旋的二维环面上开展变分蒙特卡罗计算。
2. 未见磁性或价键长程序，主导对称性通道的二聚体与自旋关联之比约2.52，且狄拉克参考态相对所选Z₂态的保真度优势随尺寸增强。
3. 共同关联标度符合涌现SO(6)单极子多重态预期，支持U(1)狄拉克自旋液体解释，但有限尺寸和参考态范围仍限制热力学极限判定。

title: Universality in Anomalous Diffusion: Power Laws and Faster-Decaying Tails
abstract: Strong anomalous diffusion is often characterized by a piecewise-linear spectrum of the moments of displacement. The spectrum is characterized by the slopes $\theta$ and $\zeta$ for small and large moments, respectively, and by the crossover moment $q_c$ at which the slope changes. The exponents $\theta$ and $\zeta$ characterize the asymptotic scaling of the bulk and of the tails of the probability distribution function of displacements, respectively. Here, we adopt asymptotic theory to match the behaviors at intermediate scales. The resulting constraint explains how distributions with algebraic tails imply strong anomalous diffusion, and it relates $q_c$ to the corresponding power law. Our theory provides universal hyper-scaling relations between the exponents characterizing strong anomalous diffusion, and it yields explicit expressions for the leading-order corrections to the asymptotic power-law behavior of the moments of displacement. We also characterize finite-time corrections and propose a robust distribution-based method to estimate $\theta$, $\zeta$, and $q_c$. The findings are supported by numerical and analytical results for three paradigmatic models exhibiting strong anomalous diffusion. Finally, we show that power-law tails are not only sufficient but also necessary for this scenario: with a Gaussian, or generally fast-decaying, bulk and exponentially rare ballistic excursions, the spectrum of moments is single-linear, and the crossover to the apparent second branch drifts with the observation time. When the bulk is fast decaying and the tail is a power law, strong anomalous diffusion is still present, but the hyper-scaling relations among the exponents are violated.
summary:
1. 作者结合渐近匹配、光晶格冷原子与莱维行走模拟及可解确定性映射，研究强反常扩散中两段线性位移矩谱的成立条件。
2. 证明可匹配分支必共享r^(-1-α)幂律区且交叉阶数q_c=α，而指数稀有弹道飞行的伪双标度随观测时间漂移或消失。
3. 分布塌缩与时间稳定性检验有望辅助实验诊断，但高斯主体叠加幂律飞行的已解模型仍有强反常扩散，超出上述匹配规则的适用范围。

title: Minimal model of a Plateau-Rayleigh instability of a solid binary alloy nanowire: impacts of surface segregation
abstract: Minimal model and its linear stability analysis (LSA) for Plateau-Rayleigh (PR) instability of an intermixed, solid binary alloy nanowire is presented. Model accounts only for the surface diffusions of the alloy components without anisotropies of a surface energies, and for a classical thermodynamic surface segregation. Model allows to assess a deviation of a longwave instability cutoff wavelength $\lambda_c$ from the classical value $2\pi r_0$ (a wire circumference) as a function of a surface composition deviation from its equilibrium value, a wire radius, and a bulk concentration of a minority component. Results of LSA are presented for AuNi, PtNi, and CoNi nanowires, where an important distinction is that a surface segregation curve for CoNi is qualitatively different from the one for AuNi and PtNi. For each nanowire there is a sizable region of a parameter space where $\lambda_c<2\pi r_0$ and correspondingly, a fastest growing perturbation wavelength $\lambda_{max}$ is also less than a wire circumference. This is in stark contrast to PR instability of a single-component nanowire transporting mass by surface diffusion - in this case $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{max}$ are larger than a wire circumference. Strong surface segregation is primarily responsible for unusually small $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{max}$. Results suggest that a large number of small and closely spaced nanoparticles may emerge upon disintegration via annealing of a binary alloy nanowire.
summary:
1. 作者建立耦合双组分表面扩散与经典偏析的各向同性模型，对AuNi、PtNi和CoNi开展线性稳定性分析，考察合金化如何改变固态纳米线的普拉托–瑞利失稳波长。
2. 表面偏析使三种合金在部分参数区间的临界及最快增长波长均小于线周长，模型给出的典型最大增长率达单组分线的数百至数千倍。
3. 这提示退火可能产生更小且更密集的颗粒链，但最终尺寸与间距尚待非线性计算和实验检验，且模型未含成分应力与衬底接触效应。

title: Crossover duality for the quantum long-range Ising chain: perturbation theory around the short-range endpoint and a DMRG test
abstract: We propose a weakly coupled description of the long-range transverse-field Ising chain near its short-range crossover at $s_*=7/4$, where the couplings decay as $r^{-1-s}$. The Ising conformal field theory is coupled to an instantaneous Gaussian field through $\sigma\chi$, extending the classical long-range Ising duality to quantum chains. The equal-time interaction generates a stress-tensor deformation that causes the velocity to run and renormalizes the dynamical critical exponent $z$. Conformal perturbation theory gives $z=1-0.720\,\delta+O(\delta^2)$, $1/\nu=(1+z)/2+O(\delta^2)$, and $\omega=\delta+O(\delta^2)$, with $\delta=s_*-s$. DMRG calculations on periodic chains of up to $128$ sites provide a consistency test using theoretical inputs for $1/\nu$ and $\omega$. After accounting for slow finite-size corrections, static and dynamical estimates of $z$ agree, supporting the crossover expansion at $s=1.5$ and a two-sided Padé interpolation at $s=1$, $1.25$, and $1.5$.
summary:
1. 针对耦合按r^(−1−s)衰减的量子伊辛链长短程交叉，作者提出伊辛共形场论耦合瞬时高斯场的对偶描述，进行共形微扰计算及至多128格点的周期链DMRG检验。
2. 等时耦合经应力张量形变驱动速度流，给出z=1−0.720δ+O(δ²)与修正指数ω=δ+O(δ²)（δ=7/4−s），解释交叉附近缓慢的尺寸修正。
3. 静态与能隙外推结果相容，但ω和1/ν取自理论，故数值仅提供一致性检验，独立测量z仍需更大系统。

title: How symmetry and complexity shape three-dimensional programmable self-assembly
abstract: Self-assembly enables complex structures to emerge from simple building blocks through local interaction rules. Are some structures intrinsically easier to design, that is, do they admit more sets of assembly rules than others? And, can this be predicted from their geometry? We address these questions using a three-dimensional polycube model with programmable face-to-face binding, defining a structure's assembly rule probability as the chance that a randomly chosen rule set produces it. For polycubes, this probability decreases exponentially with assembly complexity, the minimum information required to specify a structure's assembly rules. Intuitively, this follows because structures with low assembly complexity are generated not only by minimal rule sets but also by numerous more elaborate ones, and so arise disproportionately often. Symmetry can reduce assembly complexity by allowing the same building blocks and local interactions to be reused across different parts of a structure. Indeed, we find that the highest probability structures come from a tiny subset of highly symmetric structures. However, symmetry alone does not determine assembly complexity. Structures with the same symmetry can differ substantially in the amount of assembly information they require, depending on how effectively their global symmetry can be exploited by local growth rules. Overall, our results link information, symmetry, and assembly rule probability and suggest that identifying which geometric features permit rule reuse is central to designing minimal programmable self-assembling systems.
summary:
1. 为比较不同几何结构的自组装设计难度，作者在面互补结合的三维立方块模型中随机抽样十亿组规则，统计有限确定性产物并估计最小规则复杂度。
2. 概率的经验上界随复杂度近似指数下降，含20块的全立方对称结构出现概率较同尺寸形态均匀抽样高逾十二个数量级，而同对称性的四块方形与直杆分别至少需一类和三类构件。
3. 局部规则复用或可指导低复杂度设计，但该不可逆晶格模型所揭示的关系仍需在可逆、非晶格体系中检验。

title: Exact Rokhsar-Kivelson points hosting first-order phase transitions in $S=1$ compass models
abstract: We study $S=1$ compass models on the square and kagome lattices with bond-dependent bilinear and biquadratic interactions parametrized by an angle $\theta$. For compatible geometries, we determine the exact ground-state manifolds throughout the interval $\pi/4\leq\theta\leq3\pi/4$. At each endpoint, a product of on-site unitaries maps the Hamiltonian to the Laplacian of a configuration graph $\mathcal{G}$ in the $S=1$ Cartesian basis. These endpoints are exact Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) points, with one ground state per dynamically connected component of $\mathcal{G}$. Each such state is an equal-amplitude superposition in the transformed basis and acquires configuration-dependent phases upon transforming back to the original basis. Both models possess $m=O(L)$ independent and mutually commuting conserved $\mathbb{Z}_2$ line charges, where $L$ is the linear system size, forcing a ground-state degeneracy of at least $2^m$ at the RK endpoints. Throughout the interior region, $\pi/4<\theta<3\pi/4$, the ground-state manifold on each lattice is instead spanned by two product states, both annihilated by the Hamiltonian. On both lattices, each RK endpoint also hosts a first-order transition into this intervening interior phase spanned by the two product states with long-range order.
summary:
1. 为求解二维自旋1罗盘模型的基态，作者在几何相容的方格与kagome晶格上，用在位幺正变换将特定耦合点的近邻双线性—双二次哈密顿量化为构型图拉普拉斯算符。
2. Z₂线守恒量保证θ=π/4、3π/4两个RK端点的基态简并度至少随线性尺寸指数增长，两端点均为一级相变点，其间基态空间由两个有序积态张成。
3. 端点激发能与经典随机游走弛豫率的对应为谱研究提供途径，但精确激发态及可解区间外相图仍待求解。

title: Higher-order interactions renormalize the thermodynamic signature of neural population codes
abstract: Maximum-entropy models of neural recordings can be treated as Boltzmann distributions at a fictitious temperature $T$, with the fitted model at $T=1$. Their specific-heat peak grows with population size and approaches that temperature, which has been read as a sign of criticality. The case rests on pairwise models, yet retinal codes require higher-order interactions. The thermodynamics of a model with such interactions fitted cell by cell has not been computed. Here I compute it exactly for pairwise and third-order models of the same populations of up to $20$ retinal ganglion cells, in salamander and marmoset. The triplet terms, required by the held-out likelihood, shift the peak by more than the finite-sample bias, with opposite sign in the two retinas. The peak is lower and grows more slowly in salamander, higher and grows faster in marmoset, and lies closer to $T=1$ in both. An exact decomposition traces most of the shift to the energy variance across population spike counts. A constraint on the spike-count distribution alone reproduces all of it in salamander and over half in marmoset. A second recording of each species, re-binning, and a common-input surrogate show that the sign is set by the spike-count structure of a recording at its temporal resolution, not by species. The thermodynamic signature of a neural code is therefore set not by the data alone but by the interaction order of the model used to read it.
summary:
1. 为检验神经编码的类临界信号是否依赖模型阶数，作者精确枚举蝾螈与狨猴至多20个视网膜神经节细胞的成对及三阶最大熵模型。
2. 校正有限样本偏差后，主记录中蝾螈完整三阶、狨猴稀疏三阶模型的比热峰随细胞数增长的斜率分别为成对模型的0.84和1.55倍，峰高修正主要来自放电计数间的能量方差。
3. 重分箱可使峰高修正变号，故类临界信号须结合模型阶数及时间分辨率解释，更大群体和四阶效应仍待检验。

title: Bond-valence theory is a general electrostatic valence rule
abstract: Pauling's electrostatic valence rule assigns to each bond of a cation of charge $z$ with $n$ anion neighbors the strength $z/n$. Bond-valence theory replaces the equal split of valence among bonds by $s=\exp[(R_0-d)/B]$ in the bond length $d$ and takes the sum rule, that the valences at each atom add to its formal charge, as its first axiom. Here the bond valence is defined in the electron density. Atomic basins of a first-principles density are bounded by faces, one per bond critical point, and the electric flux of that density through a face is a charge associated with the bond. The fluxes leaving a cation sum to its basin charge by Gauss's law, so on this surface the sum rule is a theorem. Across 3680 oxides, halides, chalcogenides and pnictides the flux follows the bond-valence law site by site, with a median deviation of ten percent. The softness $B$ varies nearly an order of magnitude from stiff sulfides to softer arsenides. In all cases it is set by the electrostatic flux at atomic basin faces. $R_0$ then follows from the bond lengths and their differences.
